verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm, and buyers comparing firms could fairly ask whether clients get a structured document-collection workflow such as a portal with checklists, uploads and reminders, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes end-to-end guidance and 'helping with document maintenance', which is a service description, not a documented checklist, upload or reminder workflow. The 'attached' PDFs are informational resources, not a collection mechanism.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, evidence and document collection runs through a structured workflow (checklists, uploads, reminders) rather than email attachments
